factProposals.value: The Command Center is a static page at the repo root, published on GitHub Pages from main, that reads the .colaberry files at runtime.

decisions.statement: Every tab reads plan, progress and manifest through one data module; tabs never fetch files themselves.
decisions.rationale: so the page can be pointed at the real system later without rewriting tabs

decisions.statement: System connection indicators stay grey and 'not checked from here' until the running system reports a health check.
decisions.rationale: nothing in the repo can observe a live connection

decisions.statement: The data model is kept as a reviewable proposal file and no tables are created yet.
decisions.rationale: the model needs the student's review before anything is built on it

decisions.statement: A .nojekyll file is committed so GitHub Pages publishes the .colaberry/ folder.
decisions.rationale: Jekyll drops folders whose names start with a dot, which would hide the data files from the published page

limitations.statement: The knowledge base chat answers by matching keywords and ids against the page's data; it does not use a language model.

The synced plan.json has no requirements, guardrails, systems or measures, an empty project name, and every release and due date set to 2026-09-20, which contradicts the plan in the STORY-000 brief (REQ-001 to REQ-017, releases r0–r4 from 2026-10-27 to 2026-11-12).
plan.json lists six extra releases keyed by UUID, with no dates and no stories, alongside r0–r4.
